title: crm.order.order-submitted, payload v1
description: An order header exists in order_db with a KR-12 number, its items are known, and it is awaiting fulfilment. Produced by order-service inside the SAME transaction that writes bsn_inter/cust_ord/cust_ord_item (ADR-016 §5.1, ADR-017 §8.1). Destination: crm.order.evt.order-submitted.v1. Envelope aggregateType=order, aggregateId=orderNumber, sagaId=the client's Idempotency-Key.

orderNumber.description: The KR-12 number, allocated by the same transaction. Immutable and never reused, exactly like KR-11 — a compensated order keeps its number forever (ADR-016 §4.6).

accountNumber.description: The KR-11 billing account the sale is for. Verified Active before this fact could exist (AC-SALE-02-01).

customerNumber.description: Taken from the ACCOUNT, never from the client request — the same rule ADR-015 §5.9 enforces synchronously, because it is what makes the service-address ownership check meaningful.

serviceAddressId.description: AC-SALE-01-11: the address chosen for the main product. Ownership is validated by the consumer against customer-service, not asserted here.

campaignId.description: The PUBLIC campaign code (e.g. CMP-ADSL-01), never an internal id — so a consumer resolves it through the catalog exactly as product-service does today.

items.description: One entry per requested offer. Carries offer ids and characteristic VALUES, not product ids: products do not exist when this fact becomes true (ADR-016 §5.2), and publishing a structurally-null field would invite consumers to depend on it.

characteristics.description: characteristicId -> submitted value. Validation lives in product-service (ADR-015 §6); this is what the user entered.
